title: Preventing Online Messaging Platforms from Engaging in Illegal Activities such as Sale of Prohibited Drugs
what_it_is: Preventing Online Messaging Platforms from Engaging in Illegal Activities such as Sale of Prohibited Drugs

sections.label: Online Criminal Harms Act powers
sections.summary: OCHA lets agencies issue directions over online criminal activity and impose Codes of Practice on designated services, to be introduced this year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: For example, the Online Criminal Harms Act, otherwise known as OCHA, which MHA is operationalising progressively, empowers enforcement agencies to issue directions to online service providers, other entities or individuals, when there is reasonable suspicion that there is online activity in furtherance of specified criminal offences, such as the sale of prohibited drugs, which the Member has mentioned.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: OCHA will also allow us to issue Codes of Practice to require providers of designated online services to put in place systems, processes and measures to disrupt scams and malicious cyber activities affecting people in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: We will introduce the Codes of Practice this year.

sections.label: Online crime and drug numbers
sections.summary: Reported scam cases involving online platforms more than doubled from 2021 to 2023, while suspected Telegram drug offenders detected by CNB fell 17%.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: When we look at the number of illegal activities involving the use of online platforms over the past three years, we note that the number of reported scam cases, for example, involving the use of online platforms, in 2023 has more than doubled from that in 2021.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: In the same period, when we look at the number of suspected drug offenders who use Telegram to conduct drug transactions detected by the Central Narcotics Bureau (CNB), it has decreased by 17%.

sections.label: OCHA operationalisation timing
sections.summary: MHA has been progressively operationalising OCHA since February 2024.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: On the issue of timing, I had mentioned in the main reply that the MHA is progressively operationalising the OCHA since February 2024.

sections.label: Non-compliance and access restrictions
sections.summary: Non-compliance with a direction or written notice is an offence, and the Government can order access restrictions for non-compliant online services.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Failure to comply with the direction or written notice is an offence.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: We are working with the platforms to comply with the directions within 24 hours.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: In addition, if an online service is not compliant to the directions, the Government can also issue orders to restrict access to the service or part of the service to prevent the criminal activity and content from being assessed by persons in Singapore.
